caption:
A Chennai port terminal just set its highest container record in a decade. And broke its own record from the month before.

Chennai Container Terminal, operated by DP World, reportedly handled 93,804 TEUs across 36 vessels in October 2026 - its highest monthly throughput in a decade, beating its own prior record of 89,743 TEUs set just one month earlier. Chennai Port separately handled 9,929 TEUs in a single day on October 25, 2026 - its highest daily throughput in 5 years.

Two records, one month apart, at the same terminal. That's a port handling more cargo, faster, than it has in ten years.

Sources: India Shipping News, DT Next (2026)
